mentions.name: HiRAM Deals
mentions.description: A rapid discovery and filtering tool for finding competitively priced workstations with 32GB to 2TB of RAM, so users can get started running local AI workflows. It is a free-to-use affiliate site with strict quality controls on the listings that are retained.
mentions.problem: Finding competitively priced workstations with 32GB to 2TB of RAM to actually get started running local AI workflows is difficult.
mentions.audience: People who want to get started running local AI workflows on their own hardware.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a HiRAM Deals, a rapid discovery and filtering tool for finding  competitively priced workstations with 32GB - 2TB of RAM so you can actually get started and run all the local AI workflows you read about every day.

https://www.hiramdeals.com/list
